name: The St. Regis Bangkok
positioning: St. Regis hotel on Rajadamri Road in central Bangkok, with direct Skytrain access, views over the Royal Bangkok Sports Club, a one-Michelin-star restaurant and 24-hour butler service
best_for: Travelers who want a base on Rajadamri Road with direct BTS Skytrain access, near the Erawan Shrine, Siam Paragon and Lumphini Park
Food lovers interested in IGNIV's sharing-style fine dining, Japanese izakaya fare and afternoon tea
Guests who value butler service and wellness treatments such as cryotherapy and IV drips

facts.text: The hotel is on Rajadamri Road, with direct BTS Skytrain access via a skybridge.
The hotel looks out over the greenery of The Royal Bangkok Sports Club and the Siam skyline.
The Erawan Shrine, Siam Paragon, Central World and Lumphini Park are nearby.
IGNIV Bangkok is a one-Michelin-star restaurant by Swiss chef Andreas Caminada.
Spanish interior designer Patricia Urquiola designed IGNIV's interiors.
Zuma is a Japanese restaurant inspired by traditional izakaya.
VIU serves Italian Mediterranean dishes inspired by Chef Matteo Fontana's heritage.
Afternoon tea is served overlooking the golf course, with TWG tea or coffee.
Bathrooms are marble-lined, with a rainforest shower and a separate soaking tub.
Caroline Astor Suites are corner suites with floor-to-ceiling windows and panoramic views of the city and parkland.
The hotel has a 15th-floor outdoor pool bar.
The fitness center has a Thai boxing ring for one-to-one training.

highlights.text: IGNIV Bangkok is the first IGNIV location outside Switzerland, built around a fine-dining sharing concept.
St. Regis Butler service is available 24 hours a day, and butlers can be reached at any hour by chat through the Marriott Bonvoy app.
The spa, Bangkok LIFE Longevity & Biohacking Hub, focuses on advanced diagnostics and biohacking, with treatments including cryotherapy, IV drips and hyperbaric oxygen chambers.
The St. Regis Bar serves the Siam Mary, a Thai take on the St. Regis Bloody Mary.
The Owner's Penthouse is a two-story, three-bedroom residence with a balcony and a private pool.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.
The pool has an attendant, but the hotel does not provide lifeguards.
Children aged 12 and under may not use the Exercise Room and spa facilities.
